name: io.github.y0sif/taria-mcp
title: taria
description: Read a ratatui app's widget tree and act on its widgets by id, instead of scraping the screen

packageArguments.name: --app
packageArguments.description: Label of the taria-enabled app to drive, the one it binds its socket (or, on Windows, its pipe) under

packageArguments.name: --tree-format
packageArguments.description: How trees are shown to the agent: the app's JSON snapshot, or one indented line per node
